text: A Gromark key grows its digits by adding earlier ones; Scheidt spoke of other number bases. Base 10 with three terms was closed (0107); here every other base.

Every rule, every starting run of digits, four ways of applying the digit to the letter, with any mixed alphabet: where the known message repeats a letter, the digits must line up exactly, then all 24 letters must match one to one.
Nothing fits K4 or a scrambled copy in 1.5 billion starting runs; planted texts are found. F5.2 closed.
